errorCodes.doc: The key identifier is null, empty, whitespace, or contains characters outside the JWKS-safe charset [A-Za-z0-9_-].
The key identifier exceeds the maximum length of 64 characters.
The specified key domain is not a member of the recognized key-domain catalog.
A rotation-policy duration is non-positive, or the cadence is shorter than grace plus smoke-soak.
The smoke-soak window has not yet elapsed; the pending key may not be activated.
The supplied smoke proof was issued for a different key type than this key.
The retirement grace window has not yet elapsed; the retiring key may not be retired.

A required argument supplied to a key-lifecycle transition was null, empty, or otherwise violated a documented precondition. This is a programmer/precondition error surfaced as a flagged 500 result (carrying telemetry) rather than a thrown exception.
No managed key matching the supplied identifier (or the requested live key for a domain) exists in the store.
The requested lifecycle operation is not legal for the key's current state (e.g. activating a key that is not pending, or retiring a key that is not retiring).
A live pending key already exists for the domain; a second pending key may not be generated until the existing one is activated or compromised.
The cryptographic smoke test for the key material did not pass; the key cannot be activated. Surfaced as a flagged internal-error result so the failed material never enters service.

The workload identity is null, empty, whitespace, exceeds the maximum length, contains characters outside the allowed lowercase charset [a-z0-9-], or (when parsed from a certificate subject-alternative-name) does not match the spiffe://d2.internal/workload/<service> grammar. Coarse on purpose so the peer-validation surface does not leak which check failed.

A certificate-generation precondition was violated (empty subject name, non-positive validity) or a cryptographic build operation failed. This is a programmer/precondition error surfaced as a flagged 500 result (carrying telemetry) rather than a thrown exception, the same way a failed smoke test is.

No active issuing intermediate certificate authority is available to sign a workload leaf certificate. A retryable not-ready-yet condition: the CA either has not been seeded yet or is between rotations. Surfaced as a 503 service-unavailable result so callers retry rather than treat it as a client-side conflict.
